claims.statement: From 2026, covered importers above the threshold must report embedded emissions and surrender purchased CBAM certificates; certificate cash cost is a current measurable exposure.
The authorised CBAM declarant buys certificates, making import finance, customs or sustainability leadership a plausible budget owner.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: CFO, head of customs or sustainability director at a covered importer
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: The tool connects purchase orders, supplier emissions evidence and quarterly certificate prices into cash exposure; generic ESG software often stops at reporting.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own importer subscriptions; importers retain supplier and customs relationships.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Customs brokers and trade-finance advisers refer importers; founder-led outbound can be asynchronous.

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Assumption: 8,000-20,000 PLN per mid-market importer due to enterprise trust requirements.
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: 20-50 onboarding hours per importer; quarterly data QA.
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Legal review, security, insurance and carbon-method specialists estimated at 20,000 PLN monthly at scale.
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Annual subscription by import volume and supplier count.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Supplier-data ingestion, support and specialist review.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Customs suites and ESG platforms will add CBAM modules; defend through cash forecasting and supplier evidence quality scoring.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Importer purchases and surrenders CBAM certificates; poor emissions data or procurement choices increase the certificate cash requirement.
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: First material covered shipment, supplier default-value shock or treasury forecast variance.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual contract and each quarterly certificate-price update.

contrary_evidence: The 50-tonne threshold removes many small importers.
Large importers may buy CBAM capability from existing customs or ERP vendors.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Unknown; proposed importer subscription and data-processing agreement are unsigned.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Offer spreadsheet-based exposure diagnostics using customer-uploaded customs data; if importer access fails, sell supplier evidence preparation instead.
critical_control_point.current_owner: Importers own purchase and customs records; suppliers control primary emissions evidence; the Commission publishes certificate prices.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own importer subscriptions; importers retain supplier and customs relationships.
critical_control_point.duration: Unknown until an importer contract is signed.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No existing importer or supplier data rights are established.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder would control the forecasting software; importers control data access and compliance decisions.
critical_control_point.subject: Importer CBAM cash-exposure workflow

economics.acquisition_route: Sell a fixed-price cash-exposure diagnostic to 10 Polish importers, then convert recurring users to annual forecasting subscriptions.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 120 customers at 60,000 PLN ARR yields 7.2M PLN ARR; at 25% owner earnings and 4x ARR, a 70% stake exceeds 5M PLN in years 6-9. Enterprise CAC and incumbent pressure are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 20 hours weekly during validation; specialist contractors handle methodology review.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription less ingestion, support and specialist QA; target 80%.
economics.payback: Target customer payback through a 1-3% reduction in certificate exposure or one avoided forecast error; must be proven per importer.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Quarterly prices, shipments and annual declarations create recurring work.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned supplier evidence-quality benchmarks and exposure scenarios.
fingerprint.customer: EU mid-market importers of steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity or hydrogen.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Annual CBAM cash forecasting and supplier evidence SaaS.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Importer pays subscription against certificate purchase and surrender events.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Covered import volume crosses threshold or treasury exposure becomes material.

founder_fit: High contract value limits customer count
Can validate with diagnostics before full build
risks: Enterprise sales may exceed part-time capacity.
ERP and customs incumbents can bundle functionality.

structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: proposed procurement to treasury cbam forecast gate
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: supplier emissions and importer customs data

structure.control_point: Forecast used before procurement and certificate budgeting

thesis: Own the decision layer between supplier emissions evidence and treasury cash planning, where CBAM creates a current certificate cost.
title: CBAM Cash-Exposure Engine
